findings.title: Changed hunks show no slips in the serializer logic or its specs
findings.description: I traced each branch of `website_name` against the new spec cases. `example.com/user` with hostname `discourse.org` returns `example.com`, with hostname `example.com` returns `example.com/user`, and with hostname `forums.example.com` returns `example.com/user`. These match the expectations in `spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb`. `include_website_name` and the `:website_name` attribute entry are consistent with each other.

findings.title: Removal of `websiteName` from the controller is unverified against other references
findings.description: The diff removes `websiteName` from `controllers/user.js.es6` and switches `user.hbs` to `model.website_name`. Other templates or components could still reference `websiteName`, and I could not search for them. Checking for remaining references would confirm the rename is complete.

findings.title: Websites without a URL scheme produce no website name
findings.description: `URI(website.to_s).host` returns nil for a value such as `example.com` with no scheme, so `website_name` returns nil and the template hides the link. This is consistent with the code as written. It only matters if profile websites can be saved without a scheme, which I could not check.
